intro.en: Temporary and lasting birth control asked in the practical exam: barriers, hormonal tablets, rings, patches, shots, implants, womb devices, emergency cover and sterilisation.
Comprehensive guide to intrapartum electronic fetal monitoring covering equipment, DR C BRAVADO interpretation framework, physiological abnormalities, and NICE/RCOG clinical management guidelines.
Comprehensive clinical and surgical staging classifications defined by the International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics for gynaecological cancers and gestational trophoblastic disease.
Practical examination guide covering obstetric forceps design and classifications, specific forceps varieties, and vacuum extraction devices.
Comprehensive practical examination guide covering obstetrics and gynaecological instruments, cervical sampling and cytology methods, laparoscopy equipment, and hysteroscopic assemblies.

Comprehensive pharmacology and practical examination review of 49 essential drugs in obstetrics and gynaecology, detailing indications, clinical regimens, dosages, adverse reactions, contraindications, and viva questions.
Core surgical and minor procedures in obstetrics and gynaecology, detailing operative steps, clinical indications, anatomical landmarks, complications, and viva examination spotters.
Practical exam guide to the fetal skull and maternal pelvis models, detailing skull bones, sutures, fontanelles, obstetric diameters, pelvic planes, and pelvic architecture.

title.en: Anthropometry and nutritional assessment in children

intro.en: Measuring growth, grading undernutrition, reading dehydration and deficiency signs, and screening for dysmorphism at the paediatric bedside.
How a child with suspected heart disease is examined, from pulses and pressures to murmurs, diagnosis and blueness.
Comprehensive clinical template for taking and presenting a paediatric case history and physical examination.

title.en: Central nervous system examination in children

intro.en: Bedside testing of a child with a suspected nerve or muscle disorder, from history and higher functions through cranial nerves, motor, sensory, reflex, cerebellar and meningeal signs.
Principles of child development, milestone progression across motor, social, and language domains, and developmental screening.
Nutritional history taking, daily calorie and protein calculations, food composition reference values, and infant feeding rules.
Weight based doses, indications and contraindications of the drugs most often asked in the paediatric practical exam.
How a child with belly complaints is examined, from the mouth and belly inspection to liver, spleen, fluid and gut sounds.
Systematic bedside approach to paediatric general physical examination, vital signs, temperature patterns, pulse palpation, blood pressure measurement, and respiratory dynamics.
Plotting and interpreting weight and height for age charts for girls and boys.
Vaccines tested in the paediatric practical exam: types and routes, dose rules, cold chain, individual vaccines, and the national and IAP schedules.
Normal values, memory hooks, syndromes and ward routines that round off the paediatric practical exam.
History taking, examination and resuscitation of the newborn, with the scores, charts and common problems asked in the practical exam.
Bedside procedures, biopsy techniques, aerosol devices and ward instruments tested in the paediatric practical exam.
How a child with breathing difficulty is examined, from history and chest inspection to tapping, listening and reading the signs.
The Modified Kuppuswamy scale used to grade family socioeconomic status in the paediatric case sheet, with pedigree degrees for family history.

title.en: Sexual maturity rating and pubertal assessment

intro.en: Tanner staging of breast, genital and pubic hair development with pubertal timing and wrist bone age.
Bedside vocabulary for describing paediatric rashes and bleeding spots by appearance and size.
Systematic reading of chest, neck, abdominal and bone films plus the classic signs asked in the paediatric practical exam.
